messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: HIGH - inference-gateway error-rate spike (5xx). Alert id PD-98321. Overall 5xx rate 18% in last 1m, baseline 0.6%. region: us-west1.

pagerduty: Auto-page sent to on-call rotation (sasha). Escalation policy: inference-prod.

sasha: acked. I'm on it — joining. Any known deployment?

matt: I saw a canary redeploy about 2m ago to edge-proxy:v2.4. Could be related. Opening logs.

ben: oncall FYI, infra telemetry shows kvcache eviction spikes across the pool starting ~00:16 UTC. Eviction rate up 1200x.

irina: Support: seeing customer error reports for chat sessions failing with 502s, ticket volume ramping. Notified CS lead.

opsbot: Runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/inference/gateway-5xx (recommended steps: check canary, kv cache, backend availability, traffic shift).

sasha: running initial checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=edge-proxy`

sasha: pods look healthy but restarting counts up. Attaching quick logs:
```
[edge-proxy] 2026-03-15T00:16:12Z WARN kvcache: miss=12345 evict=987
[edge-proxy] 2026-03-15T00:16:13Z ERR handler: upstream 502 for /v1/generate
```

matt: can you curl the upstream model routers? `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://internal-router-usw/model-v1/health`

ben: router health checks return 200. Problem looks concentrated at edge-proxy layer. Eviction suggests memory pressure/OOM in sidecars or aggressive LRU.

irina: Customer impact summary so far: ~3% of paid requests failing, intermittent across tenants in us-west. CS flagged 2 paying customers with visible errors.

sasha: I want to rollback the edge-proxy canary to previous stable. matt, can you approve?

matt: +1. Rolling back canary now. Command: `kubectl set image deployment/edge-proxy edge-proxy=registry/edge-proxy:v2.3 -n inference`

opsbot: Deploy bot: rollback job started by matt. Tracking: deploy-8472.

ben: while rollback running, suggest warming kvcache prefix for heavy routes to reduce misses: enabling prefix cache for /v1/generate for 30m. patch attached.

sasha: applied prefix cache patch. Also increasing pod memory for edge-proxy from 1.5Gi -> 3Gi to test. matt please watch quota.

matt: scaling memory now. `kubectl patch deploy edge-proxy -p ...` Logs show rollout progressing.

incident-bot: Alert update: 5xx rate dropping to 9% (1m window).

irina: Customer visible errors decreased but still seeing bursts in one shard. CS: onboarding customers in that shard affected.

ben: I pulled heap profiles from a failing pod. Looks like a cache bloom filter rebuild loop — aggressive eviction leading to regen storms. I'll open a short circuit to reduce rebuild frequency.

sasha: timeline check: pager fired 00:16. rollback started 00:19. Cache patch applied 00:21. Memory increase 00:22.

tim: I'm going to throttle ingress from edge-lb to prevent fanout. `traffic-shaper set inference-gateway --rate 80%` to reduce peak.

matt: Confirmed rollback completed at 00:25, pods converged to v2.3. Edge logs look much quieter.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: Alert severity downgraded to MEDIUM. Auto-escalation suppressed.

irina: CS note: we've posted status update to affected customers and created interim mitigation plan.

ben: I've pushed a hotfix that reduces kvcache rebuild frequency and turned on a transient backoff. Will monitor metrics for 15m.

sasha: monitoring: 5xx now steady at 1.2% (last 5m). TTFM improved. Good sign.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by sasha. No further escalations.

matt: follow-ups: open ticket to investigate canary rollout gating and add canary smoke that hits kvcache heavy paths. Also add RBAC to prevent memory reductions in future deploys without perf test.

irina: I'll coordinate customer communications: follow-up with affected customers, include mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix.

opsbot: Post-incident tasks created: GH-4123 (canary gating), GH-4124 (kvcache backoff tuning), OPS-789 (alert tuning).

sasha: good work everyone. I'll keep the thread open for 1 hour for monitoring. Ping me if 5xx creeps back. :thumbsup:

ben: quick note — logs and heap dumps uploaded to artifacts: https://artifacts/redwood/3250001234/heap-dumps.zip

matt: leaving handoff to night oncall at 01:00UTC. Irina, handoff notes added.

irina: acknowledged, will monitor overnight with CS on standby.

incident-bot: Thread closed for automated paging at 00:29 UTC. If new alerts appear, a new page will be opened.
